title: Vehicle intake
lead: Vehicles coming into the workshop from the shared sheet, the phone, the ERP and typed entries. Each goes to the supervisor on shift at its site and stays listed until someone releases it.
deniedBody: You need the Add workshop vehicles or Confirm workshop vehicles permission. Ask an administrator.
loadErrorTitle: The intake list could not be loaded
loadError: Could not load the workshop intake list.
noSupervisor: No supervisor on the roster for this site; sent to the area manager
linkSuggestion: ERP job card {jc} may belong to this vehicle. Check and add it.
confirmError: The vehicles could not be confirmed.
returnError: The vehicle could not be returned.

sheet.title: Vehicle intake sheet
sheet.pickCountry: Choose one country at the top of the page first. Vehicles are entered per country.
sheet.hint: Type one vehicle per row, or paste rows copied from Excel or Google Sheets. Plate and type fill in from the fleet register.
sheet.sendError: The vehicles could not be sent.
sheet.problems: {n} rows need fixing before they can be sent.
sheet.fleetError: Plate and type could not be looked up. You can still send; the server checks the vehicle.
sheet.pastedWithHeader: {n} rows pasted, columns matched by their headers.
sheet.result: {added} new, {updated} updated, {same} unchanged, {listed} already in the workshop, {bad} not valid.

waiting.lead: {n} vehicles were routed to you. Check each one and confirm it, or return it with a reason.
waiting.returnTitle: Return {asset} to the person who entered it
waiting.ownEntry: You entered this one; another supervisor confirms it.
waiting.emptyBody: New vehicles routed to you appear here within 20 seconds.

list.emptyTitle: No intake vehicles in the workshop
list.emptyBody: Vehicles added from the sheet, the phone or the ERP appear here until they are released.
list.outcomeNote: The vehicle stays in the list until it is released.

roster.lead: Who confirms the vehicles of each site. Day shift {day}, night shift {night} (site time). Off shift, the vehicle goes to the other supervisor, then the area manager.
roster.saveError: The roster could not be saved.
roster.emptyTitle: No supervisors on the roster yet
roster.emptyBody: Until a site has a supervisor, its vehicles go to the area manager.

checks.lead: Patterns worth a look. A flag is not proof of anything; open the vehicle history before acting.
checks.loadError: The checks could not be loaded.
checks.emptyBody: No unusual entries in the last 14 days.

explain.backdated_entry: Production out is more than 3 days before the entry was made.
explain.clock_mismatch: The device time was more than 30 minutes away from the server time.
explain.quick_release: Released {minutes} minutes after it was entered.
explain.outcome_flip_flop: The outcome was changed {changes} times in 7 days.
explain.bulk_confirm_many_sites: {name} confirmed {vehicles} vehicles from {sites} sites within 10 minutes.

sheets.lead: A Google Sheet can send new rows every 5 minutes. Register it here, then follow docs/workshop-status/INTAKE_SHEET_SETUP.md in the sheet.
sheets.name: Sheet name
sheets.made: Registered. Put this id in the sheet's Script Properties as TP_SHEET_ID: {id}
sheets.loadError: Could not load the connected sheets.
sheets.saveError: The sheet could not be registered.
sheets.emptyBody: Vehicles can still be added on the Add vehicles view and from the phone.
